Conversant Capital, an opportunistic real estate investment firm, has announced the final close of its inaugural private investment fund, Conversant Private Investment Fund (CPIF), with $845 million in equity capital commitments. This includes approximately $705 million in equity capital commitments raised for the commingled fund, exceeding its original target of $500 million by more than 40 percent, with the remainder raised for dedicated co-investment vehicles. CPIF is backed by a diverse group of sophisticated global institutional investors, composed of both repeat and new Conversant partners, representing sovereign wealth funds, university endowments, foundations, healthcare institutions, pension plans, asset managers and family offices. With the fund’s closing, Conversant now manages approximately $3.2 billion in assets.

p: 기회주의적 부동산 투자 운용사인 Conversant Capital이 첫 번째 사모투자펀드인 Conversant Private Investment Fund(CPIF)의 최종 펀드레이징을 8억 4,500만 달러의 지분 출자 약정으로 완료했다고 발표했다. 여기에는 공동 펀드를 위해 모금된 약 7억 500만 달러의 지분 출자 약정이 포함되어 원래 목표치였던 5억 달러를 40% 이상 초과 달성했으며, 나머지는 전용 공동투자 비히클을 위해 조달되었다.
